messages: emma: Heads up — I noticed in the Playground run history that function outputs are collapsed and labeled 'Output'. Two problems: errors are easy to miss, and screen-reader users can't tell if a collapsed run has an error. Mockup pasted below. raj: Yeah saw that. Is the issue that we label everything 'Output' instead of 'Tool response' or 'Result'? Also collapsed rows currently hide the small red error dot until you expand. sophia: a11y: Agree. For screen readers we should expose a status snippet in the collapsed summary, e.g. '1 error' or 'Succeeded'. Also add an aria-live region for runtime updates so announcements are read. emma: Proposed micro changes: 1) change label from 'Output' -> 'Tool result' 2) show a small status phrase after timestamp '• 1 error' 3) collapsed rows should surface an action 'Expand (errors)' when there are errors. mike: I'm worried about noise on busy pages. Can we make the status phrase visually subtle (low-contrast) while still exposed to screen readers? Also token counts need to stay visible for cost debugging. raj: Implementation idea: keep visual label short 'Result' but add a visually-hidden span for SRs: 'Tool result — 1 error'. Add a tooltip on hover. For keyboard, make the expand button tabbable and include aria-expanded. (sophia): Copy options: 'Tool result' vs 'Execution result' vs 'Invocation output'. I lean toward 'Invocation output' for clarity, but 'Tool result' is shorter. emma: Quick mockup: https://figma.com/s/placeholder-runhistory — shows expanded error inline and a 'Show details' button. Also added an icon: ⚠️ for error rows with aria-label='Contains error'. raj: Small code snippet I'm thinking of: ``` Invocation output — 1 error ``` mike: Perf note: expanding many runs can cause heavy re-renders. Suggest lazy-mounting details only when visible and keeping shallow snapshots for collapsed rows. sophia: Also keyboard shortcut proposal: when focus is on a run row, Enter or Space toggles expand. For VO users, ensure focus moves into the details' first focusable element after expand. emma: Copy tweak: instead of 'Show details' I'm thinking 'Open response' or 'Open result'. Which do folks prefer? raj: Prefer 'Open response'. sophia: Prefer 'Open result' (reads clearer with 'invocation' language). mike: 'Open response' OK by me. emma: OK — default to 'Open response' + sr-only 'Invocation output — 1 error' + add aria-live for status updates. I'll open a PR with the changes and the figma link. devex-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1423 — title: 'run history: expose error state & a11y improvements' (linking mockup: https://figma.com/s/placeholder-runhistory). raj: I'll review the PR tomorrow. tiny nit: add unit tests covering accessible name and keyboard toggle. sophia: I'll add a quick VO test plan into the PR description. emma: thanks all! :thumbsup: mike: :shipit: once tests pass.
